type Counter = { value: number; read(this: { value: number }): number };
const counter: Counter = { value: 3, read() { return this.value; } };
let evaluations = 0;
function getCounter() {
  evaluations++;
  return counter;
}
function getKey(): 'read' {
  evaluations++;
  return 'read';
}
console.log((counter.read as Counter['read'])(), counter.read!());
console.log((<Counter['read']>getCounter()[getKey()])(), evaluations);
function read(value?: Counter): number | undefined {
  return value?.read!();
}
function optionallyCall(value?: Counter): number | undefined {
  return (value?.read!)?.();
}
console.log(read(counter), read(), optionallyCall(counter), optionallyCall());
const identity = { x: 4, self<T>(this: T): T { return this; } };
console.log(identity.self!().x);
